stories.title: Allies open urgent regional security talks
stories.summary: Atlantic allies opened urgent talks after regional security conditions deteriorated, focusing first on civilian protection and diplomatic access. Officials said further decisions would depend on independently verified developments and consultations continuing throughout the day among defense and foreign ministers from member states.
